$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON schema, for editors.

extends.description: Presets this config builds on. v0.1 has "recommended". Lists of tables add to the preset's; other values replace them.

enabled.description: Agents whose hook files `cagr sync` writes.

command.description: How the generated hook files call cagr. "{root}" becomes the repo root for each agent.

nested_docs.description: Write a CLAUDE.md that imports AGENTS.md next to every AGENTS.md that has no CLAUDE.md.

protected_branch.description: Branch agents may not push to. Empty string turns the check off.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match.

example.description: A valid value, shown in the block message.

branch_name.description: Branch name rule, checked on push.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match.

example.description: A valid value, shown in the block message.

commit_message.description: Commit subject rule, checked by the commit-msg hook.

commit_types.description: Types allowed in branch names and commit subjects.

pre_push.description: Commands the pre-push hook runs. A failure stops the push.

block_hook_skips.description: Block --no-verify, changing core.hooksPath, and setting the skip variable.

skip_env.description: Environment variable a human sets to skip the git hooks. Agents may not set it.

hooks_path.description: Folder for the git hooks, set as core.hooksPath.

worktree_only.description: Keep the main checkout clean: agents edit and commit only in worktrees.

worktree_dir.description: Folder inside the main checkout where worktrees live.

language.description: typescript, javascript, python, go, rust, or any name.

package_manager.description: The only package manager agents may use for this ecosystem.

paths.description: Globs, relative to the repo root, this stack covers.

extensions.description: File extensions this stack checks. Defaults depend on the language.

on_edit.description: Commands run after each edit, on changed files only. {files} becomes their paths.

on_turn_end.description: Commands run before the agent may end a turn that changed files here.

stack.description: One entry per language area of the repo.

glob.description: A glob. Without a slash it matches the file name anywhere.

reason.description: What to do instead. Shown to the agent.

match.description: Words that, in order, inside one command, block it. Quotes and heredoc bodies are text, not commands.

reason.description: What to run instead. Shown to the agent.

id.description: A unique name, shown in each finding. `cagr explain <id>` prints the rule.

files.description: Globs, relative to the repo root, of the files this rule checks.

ignores.description: Globs of files this rule skips.

name.description: A regular expression the file name must match, without its extensions: `user-card` for user-card.test.tsx.

allowed.description: Globs where the files may live. A matching file outside all of them is a finding.

message.description: What is wrong. Shown to the agent.

instead.description: What to do instead, so the agent can fix it.

layout.description: Layout rules: file names and where files may live. Checked when a file is created, after each edit, at turn end, and in `cagr check` and `cagr ci`.

enabled.description: Gate pull requests on a review by a reviewer agent in a fresh context.

gate.description: Commands that need a passing review of the current commit, matched like [commands] blocked.

reviewer.description: "auto", "claude", "codex", or a command. A command gets {prompt_file} and {schema_file} and prints the findings as JSON.

model.description: Model for the reviewer agent, if not its default.

guide.description: The repo's review instructions, read into every review. Missing is fine.

effort.description: quick: one finder. standard: a bug finder, a security finder and a verifier. deep: three finders and three voting verifiers. High-risk changes always get deep.

security.description: Run a security finder in standard and deep reviews.

max_rounds.description: After this many rounds the reviewer asks the author to step back and rethink the approach.

timeout_seconds.description: How long one reviewer agent may run.

skip.description: Globs the reviewer does not review.

pr_sections.description: Headings a pull request body must have. `gh pr create` without them is denied.

agents_may_merge.description: Let agents run `gh pr merge` and `gh pr review --approve`. Off: approval stays with a person.

review.description: The review gate and the reviewer agent.

default.description: Tier of a file no [[risk.paths]] entry matches.

owners.description: Code owners for these files, written to CODEOWNERS (@user or @org/team).

reason.description: Why these files carry this tier.

paths.description: A file takes the highest tier of the entries it matches. The change takes the highest tier of its files.

risk.description: Risk tiers set by the change, not the author. Low needs no approval, medium one, high two.

github.description: `cagr sync` writes the GitHub workflow, the pull request template and CODEOWNERS.

review.description: The workflow reviews each pull request with `cagr review --ci`. Needs the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret.

nightly.description: Globs the workflow reviews every night with `cagr review --scan`, opening an issue for findings.

install.description: The shell command the workflow uses to install cagr.

brief.description: Extra lines for the session start brief.
